src-ui/src/components/Checkbox.css.reason: The shared checkbox control's own 44px touch floor. Nothing above it owns this control's box.

src-ui/src/components/DetailHeader.css.reason: station#923: DetailHeader is the shared detail-pane header used by 11 surfaces, and it now owns the 769-1180px tablet band that previously did not exist (layout jumped from mobile at 768px straight to desktop, squeezing the agent name to one character). Its responsive rules are deliberately RECORDED here rather than exempted via PRIMITIVE_ALLOWLIST: exemption would make future growth in this file invisible, while recording keeps it counted and capped. Promote it to a primitive only if a later change shows it needs rules this ceiling cannot hold.

src-ui/src/components/InfoTip.css.reason: The shared info-tip trigger shrinks its glyph box at 768px so the tip does not crowd the label it annotates.

src-ui/src/components/OnboardingGate.css.reason: The setup launcher is fixed shell chrome; on a short viewport it is bounded against the live toolbar and dock heights.

src-ui/src/components/PathAutocomplete.c.reason: The shared path field's dropdown drops absolute positioning on touch so it cannot open off-screen.

src-ui/src/components/Toggle.css.reason: The shared toggle's 44px pseudo-element hit box on touch — deliberately larger than the switch it wraps.

src-ui/src/components/acp-connections/AC.reason: FORK: the add-connection dialog hand-rolls the mobile bottom-sheet treatment instead of adopting the shared dialog surface. Retire with the sheet primitive (see docs note).

src-ui/src/components/attention/Attentio.reason: Left-aligns the card's action row on small screens.

src-ui/src/components/chat-dock/Backgrou.reason: FORK: hand-rolled bottom sheet, including the entrance direction that has to follow the docking edge (station#3309). Retire with the sheet primitive.

src-ui/src/components/chat-dock/ChatDock.reason: prefers-reduced-motion. Keeps `animation: none` because the exit animation is `forwards`: under the motion primitive alone a 0.01ms run HOLDS the collapsed end state instead of leaving the panel as it was.

src-ui/src/components/chat/QueuedMessage.reason: The queued-steer controls carry their own compact touch geometry, tighter than the shared floor.

src-ui/src/components/chat/chat.css.reason: Four blocks. The composer's two-row mobile stack and the composer popover sheet are this surface's own. The app-toolbar rules here are a KNOWN duplication with index.css (station#3766 records two same-specificity rules contradicting each other); the toolbar wants one mobile home. Two 480px toolbar blocks could not be folded — `__conn-name`/`__conn-note` `display` is decided again between them.

src-ui/src/components/coding-layout/Bran.reason: Two-row wrap at mobile: the commit field takes its own line while Push stays beside it.

src-ui/src/components/coding-layout/Codi.reason: The inspector stacks BELOW the editor on mobile, so its collapsed strip becomes a horizontal icon bar rather than a tall orphaned column.
The terminal strip, its tab scroller and the new-terminal sheet — plus the 16px input floor that stops iOS zooming the viewport on focus.

src-ui/src/components/coding-layout/File.reason: Taller tree rows and context-menu items on touch.

src-ui/src/components/coding-layout/Pull.reason: The PR rail becomes a full-width band above the content below 760px.

src-ui/src/components/editor-controls.cs.reason: This IS the shared editor-button primitive's touch floor — the one other stylesheets defer to (station#3783 moved their copies here).

src-ui/src/components/first-run/AboutYou.reason: First-run step: its own option touch floor.

src-ui/src/components/first-run/Coachmar.reason: First-run coachmark: its own action touch floors.

src-ui/src/components/first-run/EnginesS.reason: First-run step: its own row touch floor and centring.

src-ui/src/components/modals/NewProjectM.reason: FORK: hand-rolled modal padding/radius at 780px and 380px instead of the shared dialog surface. Retire with the sheet primitive.

src-ui/src/components/monitoring/Insight.reason: The insights tab and pill strips become horizontal scrollers and its grids single-column, so nothing forces a horizontal page scroll.

src-ui/src/components/notifications/Bann.reason: Three blocks, three different jobs: the reduced-motion `display: none` for an exiting banner (an end state, not a duration); the DESKTOP-only inset that keeps the overlay clear of a side dock; and the mobile grid that moves the actions onto their own row.

src-ui/src/components/notifications/Noti.reason: The toast stack's small-screen box (safe-area gutters, a viewport-bounded height) and its dismiss touch target.

prefers-reduced-motion. Keeps `animation: none` because the dismiss-collapse animation is `forwards`: under the motion primitive alone the row would snap to `opacity: 0.35` instead of staying legible.

src-ui/src/components/project-sidebar/Pr.reason: The app-shell navigation rail: the mobile drawer and its backdrop, the touch-only reorder/chevron geometry that has to stay inside a 44px row, and the desktop-side hides.
The drawer's status footer anchors to the device safe-area, not to the dock height — on mobile the drawer covers that dock.

src-ui/src/components/registry/ProjectLa.reason: Catalog rows drop to two columns at 480px.

src-ui/src/components/session/SessionMod.reason: FORK: hand-rolled bottom sheet. Retire with the sheet primitive.

src-ui/src/components/setup/ExistingSetu.reason: The embedded setup-import workflow stacks its own heading and full-width Review import control inside both First Run and Settings; neither host nor the shared action-row primitive owns that internal heading geometry.

src-ui/src/components/usage-stats/UsageR.reason: The receipt table and its source-coverage drawer have page-specific horizontal data and full-width mobile controls; shared dialog chrome does not own this data layout.

src-ui/src/components/usage-stats/UsageS.reason: Single-column stat cards and a viewport-bounded drill-down modal.

src-ui/src/components/voice/GlobalVoiceB.reason: The floating voice button re-anchors to the opposite corner on mobile so it never lands on the dock's send control, clamped above the collapsed bar.

src-ui/src/components/voice/VoiceOrb.css.reason: The orb's own 44px floor on touch.

src-ui/src/components/voice/VoicePill.cs.reason: The voice pill lifts above the safe-area inset and its mute control takes a 44px box.

src-ui/src/index.css.reason: The app-shell stylesheet, and the largest remaining concentration (12 blocks). It is deliberately NOT a primitive entry: it mixes genuine shell primitives (the responsive dialog surface, the toolbar, the chat dock, the global touch-target net) with page-ish rules (the command/delegation launchers, the new-chat modal), and exempting the file would let any page hide a responsive rule by moving it here. Two blocks are reduced-motion END STATES the motion primitive cannot express; one is a `prefers-color-scheme` fork that should be reading theme tokens; the rest are the shell's own mobile and desktop-only geometry. Three same-condition folds were REFUSED because a `chat-input`/`chat-dock` property is decided again in between.

src-ui/src/pages/NotificationsPage.css.reason: Stacked filter and card-footer rows on a phone. The dock clearance that used to live here is gone — the shell reserves it once (station#3902).

src-ui/src/pages/ProfilePage.css.reason: The profile hero and stats grid stack and centre at 700px.

src-ui/src/views/HomeView.css.reason: Single-column action cards, a taller card floor, and stacked task rows; plus hides the desktop-only top-actions row below 1024px, #890 mobile polish.

src-ui/src/views/IntegrationsView.css.reason: The Form / Raw JSON toggle becomes full-width equal halves; desktop keeps the compact pill.

src-ui/src/views/KnowledgeConnectionView.reason: Field and action widths for this page's two fixed cards; the 44px floors themselves already come from the editor primitive.

src-ui/src/views/MonitoringWidgets.css.reason: The monitoring dashboard's own vertical budget — an agents-list cap, a log-feed floor, a metrics cap — so the feed stays the dominant scroll region on a phone. Nothing above this page knows those proportions.

src-ui/src/views/PluginManagementView.cs.reason: The install bar's wrap behaviour and the wrapping of long plugin names, sources and git hashes.

src-ui/src/views/ProjectPage.css.reason: Three blocks at three breakpoints: task grids single-column at 760px, the live-work row's touch floor at 768px, and the page's own gutters, card grid, git-commit rows and chat CTA stack.

src-ui/src/views/ProjectSettingsView.css.reason: The section-nav horizontal scroller at 640px, and the wrapping of identity paths that would otherwise force a horizontal page scroll.

src-ui/src/views/RegistryView.css.reason: The registry's two-column tab grid and single-column card grid: the SHARED desktop grid's 320px minimum is wider than a 320px viewport once the page's gutters are taken, so this page overrides the primitive's minimum rather than the primitive changing for everyone.

src-ui/src/views/ReviewQueueView.css.reason: Three breakpoints: the two-up diff collapses at 900px (a content width, not a device), detail padding and action stretch at mobile, run-modal fields at 640px.

src-ui/src/views/ScheduleView.css.reason: The cron editor, detail fields and table scrollers; at 640px two table columns are dropped and the row name is clamped — a decision about THIS table's columns that no primitive can hold.

src-ui/src/views/SessionsView.css.reason: The session detail pane's compact ladder, including a viewport-HEIGHT rung (620px) for an open software keyboard, and the `--viewport-compact` variant that collapses only non-identity chrome (station#1170/#3305).

src-ui/src/views/SettingsView.css.reason: The overview hero grid, single-column env-var rows, and the reduced-motion outline that substitutes for the highlight pulse. (Recorded 4->3 in station#753's lane: the section-nav scroller block was removed upstream without lowering the record; count verified against origin/main.)

src-ui/src/views/TaskWorkspaceView.css.reason: Task-workspace sections and callouts stack at 640px.

src-ui/src/views/developer/SystemTab.css.reason: The only min-width query in the set: the system grid opts UP to two columns at 48rem rather than overriding a wider default down.

src-ui/src/views/editor-layout.css.reason: The editor family's shared mobile geometry — grids to one column, field and control floors, label rows wrapping. This is where the agent editor's forked `agent-editor-mobile.css` was folded back to, and it applies to every editor rather than one page.

src-ui/src/views/settings/KeyboardShortc.reason: Shortcut rows go single-column on touch and the capture control takes a 44px box.

src-ui/src/views/settings/KnowledgeStore.reason: The Obsidian action row stretches and wraps, with touch floors on its controls.

src-ui/src/views/skills-view.css.reason: Skill-detail padding and full-width actions at mobile, and variables rows at 768px. The dock clearance that used to live here is gone — the shell reserves it once (station#3902).

src-ui/src/workspace-panes/BasisPaneLaun.reason: Basis is a long-form disclosure surface: its responsive fallback intentionally becomes a full-height phone sheet while the shared dialog primitive retains bounded-height behavior for ordinary prompts.

src-ui/src/workspace-panes/SpatialBoardW.reason: The Work Board owns two compact contracts: phone/coarse viewport stacking and pane-width container behavior that makes the ordered list primary while the canvas is opt-in. Its variable reference fields, camera, and card plane cannot be inferred by the shared host.

src-ui/src/workspace-panes/WorkspacePane.reason: Touch-only geometry for the availability toggle.
Pane tabs take a touch floor and the review panels stack below 760px.

src-ui/src/views/BoardView.css.reason: The board grid collapses its ordinal multi-column span layout to one column on narrow viewports; column count derives from BoardWidget size presets — a board-layout concern no shell primitive owns.

src-ui/src/workspace-panes/SessionInvent.reason: The inventory group index switches from a constrained desktop column to a readable one-column phone layout; shared dialog and page primitives do not own this pane-specific dependency navigation.
